comment: MASQUE config cases with Xray-core v26.11.9's `xray run -test` verdicts. `xray` is "ok" or a substring of its error; `ours` overrides the verdict xray-rust gives, for the reason in `why`; `core` is the error a configuration xray-rust takes still meets when the core starts, for the reason in `why`. scripts/check-masque-interop.sh rechecks every Xray verdict.

cases.name: numeric address
cases.xray: json: cannot unmarshal number into Go value of type string

cases.name: empty address
cases.why: an empty server address can never be dialed

cases.name: port above 65535
cases.xray: json: cannot unmarshal number 65536 into Go struct field MasqueClientConfig.port of type uint16

cases.name: string port
cases.xray: json: cannot unmarshal string into Go struct field MasqueClientConfig.port of type uint16

cases.name: fractional port
cases.xray: json: cannot unmarshal number 443.5 into Go struct field MasqueClientConfig.port of type uint16

cases.name: negative port
cases.xray: json: cannot unmarshal number -1 into Go struct field MasqueClientConfig.port of type uint16

cases.name: remoteDNS not an array
cases.xray: json: cannot unmarshal string into Go struct field MasqueClientConfig.remoteDNS of type []string

cases.name: remoteDNS number
cases.xray: json: cannot unmarshal number into MasqueClientConfig.remoteDNS.0 of type string

cases.name: remoteDNS with leading zero
cases.xray: ParseAddr("192.0.02.53"): IPv4 field has octet with leading zero

cases.name: scoped remoteDNS
cases.why: a scoped address cannot be reached through the tunnel

cases.name: nine remoteDNS
cases.why: at most 8 servers, as for WireGuard

cases.name: reality
cases.xray: infra/conf: REALITY only supports RAW, XHTTP and gRPC for now.

cases.name: masqueSettings not an object
cases.xray: json: cannot unmarshal string into Go struct field Config.outbounds.0.streamSettings.masqueSettings of type conf.MasqueConfig

cases.name: path without slash
cases.xray: infra/conf: invalid "path": custom, only the variables {target} and {ipproto} are supported

cases.name: unknown path variable
cases.xray: infra/conf: invalid "path": /m/{x}, only the variables {target} and {ipproto} are supported

cases.name: unbalanced brace
cases.xray: infra/conf: invalid "path": /m/{, only the variables {target} and {ipproto} are supported

cases.name: numeric path
cases.xray: json: cannot unmarshal number into Go struct field Config.outbounds.0.streamSettings.masqueSettings.path of type string

cases.name: authorization header with user
cases.xray: infra/conf: "headers" can't contain "authorization" when "user" or "pass" is set

cases.name: numeric header value
cases.xray: json: cannot unmarshal number into Go struct field Config.outbounds.0.streamSettings.masqueSettings.headers.X of type string

cases.name: headers not an object
cases.xray: json: cannot unmarshal array into Go struct field Config.outbounds.0.streamSettings.masqueSettings.headers of type map[string]string

cases.name: connections with concurrency
cases.xray: infra/conf: maxConnections cannot be specified together with maxConcurrency

cases.name: xmux not an object
cases.xray: json: cannot unmarshal string into Go struct field Config.outbounds.0.streamSettings.masqueSettings.xmux of type conf.XmuxConfig

cases.name: bad xmux range
cases.xray: infra/conf: Invalid integer range, expected either string of form "1-2" or plain integer.

cases.name: warp not an object
cases.xray: json: cannot unmarshal string into Go struct field Config.outbounds.0.streamSettings.masqueSettings.warp of type conf.MasqueWarpConfig

cases.name: unknown congestion
cases.xray: infra/conf: unknown congestion control: cubic, valid values: reno, bbr, brutal, force-brutal

cases.name: udp realm with udphop
cases.why: realm must be the last UDP mask and udphop sends to the server's ports, as on every carrier

cases.name: udp xicmp to a name
cases.why: Xray-core never resolves the address for xicmp and fails every dial; the core refuses it at start, as on every carrier

cases.name: udp sudoku inside xicmp
cases.why: sudoku's datagrams on QUIC exceed what an echo carries, as on every QUIC carrier

cases.name: tlshello fragment on h3
cases.why: TCP masks cannot apply to QUIC, as on XHTTP over HTTP/3

cases.name: sudoku tcp mask on h3
cases.why: the QUIC dial takes no TCP mask, which Xray-core's ignores; the core refuses them at start, as XHTTP over HTTP/3 refuses them

cases.name: header-custom tcp mask on h3
cases.why: the QUIC dial takes no TCP mask, which Xray-core's ignores; the core refuses them at start, as XHTTP over HTTP/3 refuses them

cases.name: masqueSettings on raw network
cases.xray: infra/conf: invalid "path": x, only the variables {target} and {ipproto} are supported

cases.name: vless with masque network
cases.xray: infra/conf: the masque transport can only be used by the masque outbound

cases.name: mux
cases.why: Mux is for VLESS, Trojan, Shadowsocks and VMess, as everywhere in xray-rust

cases.name: dialerProxy
cases.why: chaining is refused, as for Hysteria and WireGuard

cases.name: h2 udp noise
cases.why: UDP masks have no UDP carrier to apply to over HTTP/2, as on XHTTP over HTTP/2

cases.name: h2 udphop
cases.why: UDP masks have no UDP carrier to apply to over HTTP/2, as on XHTTP over HTTP/2

cases.name: h2 te header
cases.why: this HTTP/2 client refuses a TE header other than "trailers", which Xray's sends

cases.name: warp with user
cases.xray: infra/conf: "user" and "pass" can't be used with "warp"

cases.name: warp with pass
cases.xray: infra/conf: "user" and "pass" can't be used with "warp"

cases.name: warp with a garbage private key
cases.xray: illegal base64 data at input byte 3
